key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:3F7C
name: store_blit_request_then_wait
description: Stores a set of blitter request values, including two fixed values, into a record addressed by the base register. It then busy-waits on the blitter busy flag in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:3FBA
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Loops reading the DMA status register and tests the blitter busy flag until it clears, then returns. Nothing is written.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:3FCA
name: decode_joystick_direction_flags
description: Reads a stored joystick input word and derives horizontal and vertical direction flags from its bits, using an exclusive-or of adjacent bits for the vertical direction. It also sets fire-button flags and writes the combined result into a state record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4068
name: copy_four_longwords_to_globals
description: Calls a subroutine first, then copies four consecutive 32-bit values from the record at the incoming pointer into four global variables.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4084
name: scale_small_value_by_sixteen
description: Returns the input word unchanged when it exceeds three. Otherwise it returns the word shifted left by four bits, which multiplies it by sixteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:40B8
name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return, so it reads and writes no memory or hardware registers and acts as a no-op.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:40EC
name: draw_clipped_sprite_planes
description: Checks that a sprite record lies within the visible screen, clipping its top and bottom rows as needed. It then walks the sprite column data, shifting words by the horizontal sub-position, and calls a per-row drawing routine for each plane, using four planes when the record flag is set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:42D0
name: mask_four_word_targets
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask value into each of four words, each reached through its own address register, which clears every bit not set in the mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:42DA
name: mask_three_words_return_code
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask value into three words reached through address registers, then returns the incoming byte with a fixed pattern of bits set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4484
name: combine_mask_bits_into_planes
description: Works through up to four stored plane pointers, one per mask bit. For a set bit it ORs the complement of the value into the plane word, and for a clear bit it ANDs the value into it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:45BC
name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system library's memory allocation function through its library vector. It returns minus one when the result is a null pointer, and otherwise returns the pointer.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:45DA
name: free_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system library's memory release function through its library vector, then tests the returned value against zero and returns minus one when it is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:45FA
name: queue_row_draw_commands
description: Chooses one of two paths depending on a signed input value. For each screen row in the span it fills a blitter request record with mode, mask and offset fields derived from the vertical position, and it calls a subroutine until that subroutine reports completion.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4716
name: apply_bit_mask_four_words
description: Runs four passes over the bits of a mask value. Each pass sets a word to all ones or zero according to its bit, writes it into a request record, and calls a subroutine to obtain the next value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:477C
name: switch_display_mode_copper
description: A sentinel code skips the stored-data step, another code swaps four long words, and any other code copies four words from the given record. It then waits for a raster position, writes a copper list with colour and jump instructions into a buffer, and restarts the copper and DMA.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4950
name: handle_keyboard_scancode
description: Decodes a raw keyboard serial byte by rotating its inverted bits, then branches on the key code. Some keys write display window, display control and bitplane modulo registers, some update stored flags or values, and some wait for the key to be released.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:49A4
name: program_display_window_mode_b
description: Writes fixed values to the display window start and stop registers, the data fetch start and stop registers and the bitplane control register. The control value differs from the sibling routine by one bit, and the routine then clears four stored words and a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4A22
name: program_display_window_mode_a
description: Writes fixed values to the display window start and stop registers, the data fetch start and stop registers and the bitplane control register. The control value differs from the sibling routine by one bit, and the routine then clears four stored words and a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4A46
name: clear_four_state_words
description: Writes zero to four words in the state record addressed by the base register and clears a stored flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4A82
name: reset_two_words_set_pair
description: Clears two words in the state record, sets two other words to forty, and sets a stored flag to one.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4AF2
name: reset_input_state_from_table
description: Sets one stored word to all ones, loads the low byte of a table entry into a second stored value, and clears a third stored value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4B62
name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Loops reading the vertical position register until the raster position reaches a fixed line, then returns its input value unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4B84
name: write_dma_control_register
description: The decompiler could not finish this routine, so only its listed facts are known: it writes the DMA control register, where setting the top bit enables the channels named in the write, and it calls one other routine. The exact channel mask and call sequence are not recovered.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4C50
name: lookup_record_when_code_matches
description: When the first argument is zero, it stores the second argument into a global variable if that argument is non-zero, and otherwise calls a routine. Otherwise it looks up a record through a called routine, and when the record's type field matches a fixed code it saves the pointer held in the record and a derived value into globals.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4CBC
name: open_ciaa_and_fill_table
description: On first use it opens the ciaa resource through the exec library and calls a second library function, saving that result. It then copies a longword from each record that matches a fixed type code into a fifteen-entry table, zeroing entries that do not match, and returns a flag for whether the second call succeeded.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4D4C
name: close_ciaa_resource_if_open
description: When the open flag is set, it calls a library close function through a stored pointer and clears the flag. It calls a further routine in either case.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4D96
name: load_global_from_fixed_cell
description: Writes a constant into a global variable, then overwrites it with the value read from a fixed memory cell. The listed control register is not written in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4D9E
name: copy_stored_value_to_global
description: Copies a value read from a fixed memory cell into a global variable. The listed timer registers are not written in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4DB6
name: clear_field_in_table_records
description: Walks a table of fifteen record pointers and, for each non-null pointer, writes zero to the longword at offset eight within that record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4DCE
name: silence_audio_channels
description: Writes zero to the volume register of each of the four audio channels, then clears two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4DF2
name: silence_audio_channels_store_fifteen
description: Writes zero to the volume register of each of the four audio channels, then stores the value fifteen in a global variable.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4E10
name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine, then returns zero as its result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4E18
name: cycle_audio_channel_updates
description: Increments a stored counter, and until it reaches six it calls a routine once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, passing the channel index. When the counter reaches six it resets it and calls one more routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4E3C
name: run_routine_per_audio_channel
description: Calls a routine once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down from three to zero, and then returns its stack argument unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4E70
name: advance_channel_effect_state
description: If the stored step value is non-zero, it adds the step to a stored position, clamps the result to a limit chosen by the step's sign, and stores it. If the step is zero, it reads an effect code: code one dispatches through a jump table, while codes seven and eight set a signed parameter and look up a value in a fixed table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4E92
name: advance_position_with_lower_limit
description: Adds an input word to a stored position and raises the result to a stored minimum when it is at or below that minimum. It then stores the result in the output field and back in the position field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4EA6
name: set_channel_effect_parameters
description: For effect code one it calls a routine through a jump table indexed by a stored value, and for codes seven and eight it stores a signed low-nibble parameter, the record's key word, and a value found by searching a fixed table for the key. Other codes return without changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4EC4
name: store_key_with_table_lookup
description: Stores a low-nibble parameter from a record and the record's key word, then searches a fixed table for the key. It stores the table value at an offset chosen by a high-nibble parameter, or stores the key itself when the table has no match.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4EFE
name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Copies one word from a source address offset by a signed index, scaled to word size, into a field of the destination record. The offset is positive when the sign flag is non-zero and negative otherwise.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F10
name: store_input_word_in_record
description: Writes the incoming word into offset four of the record addressed by the destination base register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F16
name: store_signed_key_with_lookup
description: Stores a low-nibble parameter from a record, negated, together with the record's key word. It then searches a fixed table for the key and stores the table value at an offset set by the high nibble, or the key itself when there is no match.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F1A
name: dispatch_routine_by_index
description: Calls a routine chosen from a table of routine pointers by a stored index, which is decremented by one and scaled by four before use.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F52
name: lookup_table_value_by_key
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at the incoming index counted from that match into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F6C
name: lookup_table_high_nibble_offset
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at an offset from that match given by the high nibble of a record byte into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F76
name: lookup_table_low_nibble_offset
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at an offset from that match given by the low nibble of a record byte into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F82
name: copy_record_word_to_output
description: Copies the word at offset sixteen of the record into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:4F8C
name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears an enable word, calls a routine for each of the four audio channels, then writes the enable word with the DMA enable bit set. After a short delay it loads the audio location registers from a channel table, and advances a stored step counter that moves to the next buffer index and wraps it at a stored count.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5078
name: process_channel_sequence_entry
description: Processes one entry of a channel's sequence record, which supplies a value word, a data pointer and a count. It copies these into the channel's output block, adjusts the volume by the entry's parameter according to its command nibble with clamping, and stores or silences the channel for special values, recording the channel's bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:50E8
name: update_channel_volume_and_flags
description: Adjusts a channel's volume by the entry's parameter according to its command nibble, adding with an upper clamp or subtracting with a lower clamp. A special value stores a global or silences the channel, and any other non-zero value copies the channel's output fields and records its bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5124
name: add_entry_volume_and_flags
description: Sets the channel volume to a base word plus a record byte, clamped at the upper limit, then applies the same special-value handling and running-mask update as the other entry routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5156
name: store_active_channel_entry
description: For a non-zero entry, it waits briefly and then either silences the channel for the special silence value or copies the entry's pointer, length and value into the channel's output block. It sets the channel's bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5184
name: copy_channel_entry_fields
description: Copies a longword and two words from a channel record into the output block, then ORs the record's flag word into a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5344
name: fill_bitplanes_by_mask
description: Calls a routine first, then for each of four bitplane pointers fills a block of 8000 longwords with all ones or all zeros according to the matching bit of the input mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5376
name: lock_df0_volume_as_current
description: Releases any previously held DOS lock, waits for a keyboard code, pauses briefly, then locks the DF0 volume and makes it the current directory. The lock handle is kept when the lock succeeds, and otherwise a routine is called instead.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5472
name: wait_for_disk_status_clear
description: Loops reading the status port until its disk status bit clears, then calls one other routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:54B6
name: read_file_toggling_blitter_ownership
description: Releases the blitter, permits multitasking, and loops opening a file when no handle is held or otherwise seeking and reading from it, closing and reopening the file when the requested value differs from the stored one. After a successful read it forbids multitasking and claims the blitter, then calls a further routine when two stored sizes differ.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:55B0
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Calls a routine, forbids multitasking and claims the blitter, then returns minus one. A later branch that would call another routine can never be taken in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:55C0
name: store_word_in_delay_loops
description: Stores the incoming word into a global location repeatedly within nested countdown loops, which acts as a timed delay.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:55E2
name: delay_then_zero_global
description: Runs a long countdown loop as a delay, then writes zero to one global location once per step of a second loop of 4096 steps.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:560C
name: open_libraries_and_layout_buffers
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries by name and reads the available memory size. It then lays out fifteen buffer pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart in a global table, and derives further buffer addresses from the allocations and library bases.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:57E6
name: toggle_dma_channel_bits
description: Calls a routine, writes a DMA control value that clears one group of channel bits, calls another routine, and then writes a second value that sets a different group with the enable bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5808
name: register_interrupt_server_node
description: Allocates an interrupt node through a called routine, sets its data pointer to a global, its priority to one hundred and its type to two, and stores a handler routine's address. It then registers the node with the exec library's interrupt server.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:585E
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library, then claims the blitter through the graphics library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:5874
name: permit_and_disown_blitter
description: Releases the blitter through the graphics library, then re-enables multitasking through the exec library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:588A
name: start_copper_list_from_struct
description: Loads the copper list pointer from a field of a stored structure, strobes the copper jump register, and enables copper DMA through the DMA control register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)[tr en]/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2)[tr En].adf:another:0:58A8
name: call_four_routines_return_zero
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns zero.

name: stub_undecoded_library_copper_setup
description: The decompiler could not finish this routine, so only its listed facts are known. It calls library close and open functions and a forbid function, and it touches the copper pointer, the copper jump strobe, the DMA and interrupt control registers, and a CIA port register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0000
name: load_executable_hunks
description: Walks the AmigaDOS hunk records of an executable, comparing each record type with the hunk type codes. For each hunk it allocates memory and copies its contents, applies relocation records that add a base address to listed offsets, and frees a temporary buffer at the end.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0138
name: delay_by_count_word
description: Counts the incoming word down in a loop until it passes zero, so the loop length scales with the input value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:017C
name: decode_backward_compressed_stream
description: Decodes a bit-packed compressed stream into a buffer by writing from the end toward the start, alternating between literal bytes and back-references that copy a run of already written bytes. Run lengths and offsets are read through a bit reader that tests a shifted flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:01C8
name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Repeats once per unit of the incoming word count, shifting a bit buffer by the count held in a register and loading the next value from memory when the buffer empties. It tracks the last bit shifted out as the extended flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:021C
name: stub_undecoded_three_instructions
description: The decompiler could not finish this three-instruction routine, so its body is not recovered. The listed facts show only that its address is taken by a pc-relative address load and that one routine calls it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0000
name: startup_timing_setup_wait
description: Runs a series of setup calls, sets a timing value of 300 or 2400 when a status bit is set, waits until another status bit clears, clears a counter, and then runs more setup calls.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0066
name: dispatch_code_to_slot_tables
description: Matches an incoming code against a set of fixed values and, for a match, assigns slot indices and stores values read from a record into slot entries. It then resets a table of 128 words to minus one and a block of longwords to zero, and loops over 64 entries, copying and updating each active one until a stored flag changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:006C
name: dispatch_code_after_table_loop
description: Enters the same slot-table dispatch as its neighbour, matching the code at the point after the table loop and reusing the same assignment and record-store steps. It repeats the reset and update loops until the stored flag changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:012E
name: run_bytecode_script_interpreter
description: Interprets a byte-coded script, returning when an end opcode is reached or the read position leaves a bounded range. Commands copy, add, mask, shift and store 16-bit values in a register table, call subroutines, compare two values to choose a jump target, and branch while a counter is non-zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:045A
name: resume_script_if_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag from the previous comparison is set, meaning the two compared values were equal.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0462
name: resume_script_if_not_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag from the previous comparison is clear, meaning the two compared values differed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:046A
name: resume_script_if_greater
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero, overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed greater-than result. The rest of its control flow is the same interpreter as its neighbour.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0472
name: resume_script_if_not_less
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed greater-or-equal result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:047A
name: resume_script_if_less
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed less-than result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0482
name: resume_script_if_less_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag is set or the overflow and negative flags show a signed less-than result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0654
name: apply_plane_operation_record
description: Dispatches a drawing operation record. Small type codes either loop over rows or return, while other records check that the position lies on a 320 by 200 screen and then combine a mask into bitplane words at that position, using an inverted OR for one operation code, a three-plane mask combine for another, and per-plane set-or-clear for the rest.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0704
name: walk_entries_by_high_bit
description: Walks a counted list of entries whose length is chosen by the top bit of two words in each entry, and calls a routine for every entry it visits. The count is passed on the stack.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0710
name: compute_record_address_by_index
description: Returns the address of a twenty-byte record in a global table, located by the low word of the input index.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:071C
name: print_text_entry_for_key
description: Scans a table of word-keyed entries for the key held in an input register and, when one matches, passes each character of the zero-terminated text that follows it to a routine, skipping carriage-return bytes. It returns without action when no entry matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:075E
name: draw_eight_row_tile_bounded
description: Checks that a position lies within a 40 by 193 byte area, then for eight rows combines a pattern byte into four bitplane locations. Each plane uses an OR or an AND-NOT according to its bit of a mode word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:07DA
name: depack_bitstream_backward_copies
description: Depacks a bit-packed stream into a buffer working from the end toward the start. Flag bits choose between a literal byte and a back-reference that copies bytes from an offset read from the stream, and a bit reader refills its buffer as needed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:088A
name: shift_bit_window_right
description: Shifts a 32-bit bit window right by the count held in the input register. Whenever the window empties it reloads from the previous longword in memory and sets its top bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:08AA
name: select_highest_priority_object
description: Scans a table of twenty-byte records for entries whose type byte is two, keeping the one with the highest priority byte and stopping at the end marker. It then processes that record by setting its state byte and updating a stored value, or it returns when no record qualifies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09B4
name: format_word_as_text_digits
description: Converts a 16-bit value into four text characters, one per nibble from the top, using digit characters for values up to nine and letter characters above that. It returns the last character produced.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:09E6
name: mark_records_within_budget
description: Repeatedly selects the highest-priority type-three record whose side flag matches the input, marks it as type four with that flag, and subtracts its size from a running budget. The loop ends when the budget goes negative or no record qualifies, and then one other routine is called.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A48
name: mark_chained_records_within_budget
description: Marks a starting record as type four with the input flag and subtracts its size from a running budget. It then keeps selecting the highest-priority type-three record with a matching side flag and marking it the same way until the budget goes negative or none remain, and calls one other routine at the end.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0A68
name: subtract_marked_record_sizes
description: Walks the record table and, for each record of type four, calls a routine for its size and subtracts that size from one of two running budgets, chosen by the record's side flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AA6
name: walk_marked_records_subtract_sizes
description: Repeatedly subtracts an amount from one running value and walks the record table, calling a routine for each type-four record it finds. The record's side flag selects which running value takes its size, and the walk ends at the end marker.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AB4
name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged and does nothing else.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ABA
name: copy_block_shift_pointers
description: Copies a block of words from a source address up to a bound chosen by a flag into a lower destination. It then moves every record pointer that lies above the destination down by the distance the block moved.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0ADC
name: copy_run_then_shift_pointers
description: Copies a run of words from a source to a destination, then copies further full blocks, and subtracts an input amount from each record pointer above a boundary whose flag matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0AE6
name: copy_long_blocks_shift_pointers
description: Copies a number of full blocks of 32768 words from source to destination, then subtracts an input amount from each record pointer above a boundary whose flag matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B1C
name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged and does nothing else.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0B22
name: dispatch_code_with_raster_sync
description: Calls a routine first, then matches an incoming code against a set of fixed values and assigns slot indices and record values for a match. It then resets the slot tables and loops over their entries, copying and updating each active one until a stored flag changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0C9E
name: clear_out_of_range_records
description: Walks the twenty-byte record table and zeroes the first byte of every record whose type byte lies outside the range three to six. It then restores two stored values from backup copies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0CE4
name: clear_all_records_restore_values
description: Zeroes the first byte of every twenty-byte record in the table, counting down a stored record count, then restores two stored values from backup copies.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0D1A
name: count_table_entries_to_sentinel
description: Counts twenty-byte table entries until a sentinel value is found and stores the count minus one in a global variable.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:37B8
name: draw_line_with_blitter
description: Sets up the blitter to draw a line between two screen points on a 40-byte-per-row bitmap, swapping the endpoints when a flag is set. It derives the major and minor deltas and the octant bits, then writes the blitter control, modulo and size registers and starts the blit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:38D2
name: clip_line_then_draw
description: Computes edge outcode flags for both endpoints of a line and returns without drawing when both endpoints lie outside the same edge. Otherwise it clips the endpoints against the screen and calls the line-drawing routine with the clipped coordinates.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A24
name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return, so it changes no memory or registers.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A50
name: subdivide_segment_at_midpoint
description: Repeatedly splits a line segment at its midpoint and calls a routine for each piece. It stops early when the midpoint equals an endpoint or when a mask test on an accumulated flag fails.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3AE6
name: walk_scaled_polygon_vertices
description: Reads a vertex count from the record, then scales and offsets each vertex by a scale factor and an origin. For each vertex it calls a routine and uses the edge-flag bits to clamp the row value to the screen height.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3C00
name: record_polygon_row_crossings
description: Walks polygon edges row by row, scaling each endpoint and storing the crossing positions for each row in a table that ends with a sentinel value. It calls a routine for each row as it goes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3F7C
name: store_blit_request_then_wait
description: Stores a set of blitter request values, including two fixed values, into a record addressed by the base register. It then busy-waits on the blitter busy flag in the DMA status register until the blitter is idle.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FBA
name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Loops reading the DMA status register and tests the blitter busy flag until it clears, then returns. Nothing is written.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FCA
name: decode_joystick_direction_flags
description: Reads a stored joystick input word and derives horizontal and vertical direction flags from its bits, using an exclusive-or of adjacent bits for the vertical direction. It also sets fire-button flags and writes the combined result into a state record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4068
name: copy_four_longwords_to_globals
description: Calls a subroutine first, then copies four consecutive 32-bit values from the record at the incoming pointer into four global variables.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4084
name: scale_small_value_by_sixteen
description: Returns the input word unchanged when it exceeds three. Otherwise it returns the word shifted left by four bits, which multiplies it by sixteen.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40B8
name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return, so it reads and writes no memory or hardware registers and acts as a no-op.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40EC
name: draw_clipped_sprite_planes
description: Checks that a sprite record lies within the visible screen, clipping its top and bottom rows as needed. It then walks the sprite column data, shifting words by the horizontal sub-position, and calls a per-row drawing routine for each plane, using four planes when the record flag is set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42D0
name: mask_four_word_targets
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask value into each of four words, each reached through its own address register, which clears every bit not set in the mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42DA
name: mask_three_words_return_code
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask value into three words reached through address registers, then returns the incoming byte with a fixed pattern of bits set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4484
name: combine_mask_bits_into_planes
description: Works through up to four stored plane pointers, one per mask bit. For a set bit it ORs the complement of the value into the plane word, and for a clear bit it ANDs the value into it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45BC
name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system library's memory allocation function through its library vector. It returns minus one when the result is a null pointer, and otherwise returns the pointer.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45DA
name: free_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the system library's memory release function through its library vector, then tests the returned value against zero and returns minus one when it is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45FA
name: queue_row_draw_commands
description: Chooses one of two paths depending on a signed input value. For each screen row in the span it fills a blitter request record with mode, mask and offset fields derived from the vertical position, and it calls a subroutine until that subroutine reports completion.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4716
name: apply_bit_mask_four_words
description: Runs four passes over the bits of a mask value. Each pass sets a word to all ones or zero according to its bit, writes it into a request record, and calls a subroutine to obtain the next value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:477C
name: switch_display_mode_copper
description: A sentinel code skips the stored-data step, another code swaps four long words, and any other code copies four words from the given record. It then waits for a raster position, writes a copper list with colour and jump instructions into a buffer, and restarts the copper and DMA.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4950
name: handle_keyboard_scancode
description: Decodes a raw keyboard serial byte by rotating its inverted bits, then branches on the key code. Some keys write display window, display control and bitplane modulo registers, some update stored flags or values, and some wait for the key to be released.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:49A4
name: program_display_window_mode_b
description: Writes fixed values to the display window start and stop registers, the data fetch start and stop registers and the bitplane control register. The control value differs from the sibling routine by one bit, and the routine then clears four stored words and a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A22
name: program_display_window_mode_a
description: Writes fixed values to the display window start and stop registers, the data fetch start and stop registers and the bitplane control register. The control value differs from the sibling routine by one bit, and the routine then clears four stored words and a flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A46
name: clear_four_state_words
description: Writes zero to four words in the state record addressed by the base register and clears a stored flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A82
name: reset_two_words_set_pair
description: Clears two words in the state record, sets two other words to forty, and sets a stored flag to one.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4AF2
name: reset_input_state_from_table
description: Sets one stored word to all ones, loads the low byte of a table entry into a second stored value, and clears a third stored value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B62
name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Loops reading the vertical position register until the raster position reaches a fixed line, then returns its input value unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B84
name: write_dma_control_register
description: The decompiler could not finish this routine, so only its listed facts are known: it writes the DMA control register, where setting the top bit enables the channels named in the write, and it calls one other routine. The exact channel mask and call sequence are not recovered.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4C50
name: lookup_record_when_code_matches
description: When the first argument is zero, it stores the second argument into a global variable if that argument is non-zero, and otherwise calls a routine. Otherwise it looks up a record through a called routine, and when the record's type field matches a fixed code it saves the pointer held in the record and a derived value into globals.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4CBC
name: open_ciaa_and_fill_table
description: On first use it opens the ciaa resource through the exec library and calls a second library function, saving that result. It then copies a longword from each record that matches a fixed type code into a fifteen-entry table, zeroing entries that do not match, and returns a flag for whether the second call succeeded.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D4C
name: close_ciaa_resource_if_open
description: When the open flag is set, it calls a library close function through a stored pointer and clears the flag. It calls a further routine in either case.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D96
name: load_global_from_fixed_cell
description: Writes a constant into a global variable, then overwrites it with the value read from a fixed memory cell. The listed control register is not written in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D9E
name: copy_stored_value_to_global
description: Copies a value read from a fixed memory cell into a global variable. The listed timer registers are not written in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DB6
name: clear_field_in_table_records
description: Walks a table of fifteen record pointers and, for each non-null pointer, writes zero to the longword at offset eight within that record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DCE
name: silence_audio_channels
description: Writes zero to the volume register of each of the four audio channels, then clears two stored values.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DF2
name: silence_audio_channels_store_fifteen
description: Writes zero to the volume register of each of the four audio channels, then stores the value fifteen in a global variable.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E10
name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine, then returns zero as its result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E18
name: cycle_audio_channel_updates
description: Increments a stored counter, and until it reaches six it calls a routine once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, passing the channel index. When the counter reaches six it resets it and calls one more routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E3C
name: run_routine_per_audio_channel
description: Calls a routine once for each of the four audio channel register blocks, counting the channel index down from three to zero, and then returns its stack argument unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E70
name: advance_channel_effect_state
description: If the stored step value is non-zero, it adds the step to a stored position, clamps the result to a limit chosen by the step's sign, and stores it. If the step is zero, it reads an effect code: code one dispatches through a jump table, while codes seven and eight set a signed parameter and look up a value in a fixed table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E92
name: advance_position_with_lower_limit
description: Adds an input word to a stored position and raises the result to a stored minimum when it is at or below that minimum. It then stores the result in the output field and back in the position field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EA6
name: set_channel_effect_parameters
description: For effect code one it calls a routine through a jump table indexed by a stored value, and for codes seven and eight it stores a signed low-nibble parameter, the record's key word, and a value found by searching a fixed table for the key. Other codes return without changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EC4
name: store_key_with_table_lookup
description: Stores a low-nibble parameter from a record and the record's key word, then searches a fixed table for the key. It stores the table value at an offset chosen by a high-nibble parameter, or stores the key itself when the table has no match.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EFE
name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Copies one word from a source address offset by a signed index, scaled to word size, into a field of the destination record. The offset is positive when the sign flag is non-zero and negative otherwise.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F10
name: store_input_word_in_record
description: Writes the incoming word into offset four of the record addressed by the destination base register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F16
name: store_signed_key_with_lookup
description: Stores a low-nibble parameter from a record, negated, together with the record's key word. It then searches a fixed table for the key and stores the table value at an offset set by the high nibble, or the key itself when there is no match.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F1A
name: dispatch_routine_by_index
description: Calls a routine chosen from a table of routine pointers by a stored index, which is decremented by one and scaled by four before use.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F52
name: lookup_table_value_by_key
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at the incoming index counted from that match into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F6C
name: lookup_table_high_nibble_offset
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at an offset from that match given by the high nibble of a record byte into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F76
name: lookup_table_low_nibble_offset
description: Finds the record's key word in a fixed table, then writes the entry at an offset from that match given by the low nibble of a record byte into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F82
name: copy_record_word_to_output
description: Copies the word at offset sixteen of the record into the output field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F8C
name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears an enable word, calls a routine for each of the four audio channels, then writes the enable word with the DMA enable bit set. After a short delay it loads the audio location registers from a channel table, and advances a stored step counter that moves to the next buffer index and wraps it at a stored count.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5078
name: process_channel_sequence_entry
description: Processes one entry of a channel's sequence record, which supplies a value word, a data pointer and a count. It copies these into the channel's output block, adjusts the volume by the entry's parameter according to its command nibble with clamping, and stores or silences the channel for special values, recording the channel's bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:50E8
name: update_channel_volume_and_flags
description: Adjusts a channel's volume by the entry's parameter according to its command nibble, adding with an upper clamp or subtracting with a lower clamp. A special value stores a global or silences the channel, and any other non-zero value copies the channel's output fields and records its bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5124
name: add_entry_volume_and_flags
description: Sets the channel volume to a base word plus a record byte, clamped at the upper limit, then applies the same special-value handling and running-mask update as the other entry routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5156
name: store_active_channel_entry
description: For a non-zero entry, it waits briefly and then either silences the channel for the special silence value or copies the entry's pointer, length and value into the channel's output block. It sets the channel's bit in a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5184
name: copy_channel_entry_fields
description: Copies a longword and two words from a channel record into the output block, then ORs the record's flag word into a running mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5344
name: fill_bitplanes_by_mask
description: Calls a routine first, then for each of four bitplane pointers fills a block of 8000 longwords with all ones or all zeros according to the matching bit of the input mask.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5376
name: lock_df0_volume_as_current
description: Releases any previously held DOS lock, waits for a keyboard code, pauses briefly, then locks the DF0 volume and makes it the current directory. The lock handle is kept when the lock succeeds, and otherwise a routine is called instead.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5472
name: wait_for_disk_status_clear
description: Loops reading the status port until its disk status bit clears, then calls one other routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:54B6
name: read_file_toggling_blitter_ownership
description: Releases the blitter, permits multitasking, and loops opening a file when no handle is held or otherwise seeking and reading from it, closing and reopening the file when the requested value differs from the stored one. After a successful read it forbids multitasking and claims the blitter, then calls a further routine when two stored sizes differ.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55B0
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Calls a routine, forbids multitasking and claims the blitter, then returns minus one. A later branch that would call another routine can never be taken in the shown code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55C0
name: store_word_in_delay_loops
description: Stores the incoming word into a global location repeatedly within nested countdown loops, which acts as a timed delay.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55E2
name: delay_then_zero_global
description: Runs a long countdown loop as a delay, then writes zero to one global location once per step of a second loop of 4096 steps.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:560C
name: open_libraries_and_layout_buffers
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries by name and reads the available memory size. It then lays out fifteen buffer pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart in a global table, and derives further buffer addresses from the allocations and library bases.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:57E6
name: toggle_dma_channel_bits
description: Calls a routine, writes a DMA control value that clears one group of channel bits, calls another routine, and then writes a second value that sets a different group with the enable bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5808
name: register_interrupt_server_node
description: Allocates an interrupt node through a called routine, sets its data pointer to a global, its priority to one hundred and its type to two, and stores a handler routine's address. It then registers the node with the exec library's interrupt server.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:585E
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library, then claims the blitter through the graphics library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5874
name: permit_and_disown_blitter
description: Releases the blitter through the graphics library, then re-enables multitasking through the exec library.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:588A
name: start_copper_list_from_struct
description: Loads the copper list pointer from a field of a stored structure, strobes the copper jump register, and enables copper DMA through the DMA control register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h atx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h ATX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:58A8
name: call_four_routines_return_zero
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns zero.

name: stub_undecoded_library_copper_setup
description: The decompiler could not finish this routine, so only its listed facts are known. It calls library close and open functions and a forbid function, and it touches the copper pointer, the copper jump strobe, the DMA and interrupt control registers, and a CIA port register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0000
name: load_executable_hunks
description: Walks the AmigaDOS hunk records of an executable, comparing each record type with the hunk type codes. For each hunk it allocates memory and copies its contents, applies relocation records that add a base address to listed offsets, and frees a temporary buffer at the end.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:0138
name: delay_by_count_word
description: Counts the incoming word down in a loop until it passes zero, so the loop length scales with the input value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:017C
name: decode_backward_compressed_stream
description: Decodes a bit-packed compressed stream into a buffer by writing from the end toward the start, alternating between literal bytes and back-references that copy a run of already written bytes. Run lengths and offsets are read through a bit reader that tests a shifted flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:01C8
name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Repeats once per unit of the incoming word count, shifting a bit buffer by the count held in a register and loading the next value from memory when the buffer empties. It tracks the last bit shifted out as the extended flag.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro.comp:0:021C
name: stub_undecoded_three_instructions
description: The decompiler could not finish this three-instruction routine, so its body is not recovered. The listed facts show only that its address is taken by a pc-relative address load and that one routine calls it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0000
name: startup_timing_setup_wait
description: Runs a series of setup calls, sets a timing value of 300 or 2400 when a status bit is set, waits until another status bit clears, clears a counter, and then runs more setup calls.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0066
name: dispatch_code_to_slot_tables
description: Matches an incoming code against a set of fixed values and, for a match, assigns slot indices and stores values read from a record into slot entries. It then resets a table of 128 words to minus one and a block of longwords to zero, and loops over 64 entries, copying and updating each active one until a stored flag changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:006C
name: dispatch_code_after_table_loop
description: Enters the same slot-table dispatch as its neighbour, matching the code at the point after the table loop and reusing the same assignment and record-store steps. It repeats the reset and update loops until the stored flag changes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:012E
name: run_bytecode_script_interpreter
description: Interprets a byte-coded script, returning when an end opcode is reached or the read position leaves a bounded range. Commands copy, add, mask, shift and store 16-bit values in a register table, call subroutines, compare two values to choose a jump target, and branch while a counter is non-zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:045A
name: resume_script_if_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag from the previous comparison is set, meaning the two compared values were equal.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0462
name: resume_script_if_not_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag from the previous comparison is clear, meaning the two compared values differed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:046A
name: resume_script_if_greater
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero, overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed greater-than result. The rest of its control flow is the same interpreter as its neighbour.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0472
name: resume_script_if_not_less
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed greater-or-equal result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:047A
name: resume_script_if_less
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the overflow and negative flags from the previous comparison show a signed less-than result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0482
name: resume_script_if_less_equal
description: Enters the same bytecode interpreter at a point that continues directly when the zero flag is set or the overflow and negative flags show a signed less-than result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0654
name: apply_plane_operation_record
description: Dispatches a drawing operation record. Small type codes either loop over rows or return, while other records check that the position lies on a 320 by 200 screen and then combine a mask into bitplane words at that position, using an inverted OR for one operation code, a three-plane mask combine for another, and per-plane set-or-clear for the rest.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0704
name: walk_entries_by_high_bit
description: Walks a counted list of entries whose length is chosen by the top bit of two words in each entry, and calls a routine for every entry it visits. The count is passed on the stack.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:0710
name: compute_record_address_by_index
description: Returns the address of a twenty-byte record in a global table, located by the low word of the input index.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:071C
name: print_text_entry_for_key
description: Scans a table of word-keyed entries for the key held in an input register and, when one matches, passes each character of the zero-terminated text that follows it to a routine, skipping carriage-return bytes. It returns without action when no entry matches.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:075E
name: draw_eight_row_tile_bounded
description: Checks that a position lies within a 40 by 193 byte area, then for eight rows combines a pattern byte into four bitplane locations. Each plane uses an OR or an AND-NOT according to its bit of a mode word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:07DA
name: depack_bitstream_backward_copies
description: Depacks a bit-packed stream into a buffer working from the end toward the start. Flag bits choose between a literal byte and a back-reference that copies bytes from an offset read from the stream, and a bit reader refills its buffer as needed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:088A
name: shift_bit_window_right
description: Shifts a 32-bit bit window right by the count held in the input register. Whenever the window empties it reloads from the previous longword in memory and sets its top bit.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)(fr)[cr company](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)(Fr)[cr Company](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:08AA
name: select_highest_priority_object
description: Scans a table of twenty-byte records for entries whose type byte is two, keeping the one with the highest priority byte and stopping at the end marker. It then processes that record by setting its state byte and updating a stored value, or it returns when no record qualifies.
